scope: Each tissue sample was suspended in 1.2 ml lysis buffer (6M Guanadine HCl, 100mM Tris pH 8) before being probe sonicated (Misonix XL-2000) to lyse the cells.
After sonication a protein BCA assay (Thermo Scientific) was performed to determine protein concentrations of the lysate.
Trypsin was added to the protein lysate sample at a ratio of 50:1 w/v and digested overnight.
